copy.heading: Current State
copy.subheading: A detailed picture of how things stand, measured from 5.50am.
body: In this phase the engagement shadows you for a typical day, lists everything padel has quietly replaced, and counts how many times you use a particular sentence. None of it is a criticism. It is data, and you like data. You have a watch for it.

illustration.concept: Josh in pyjama bottoms and a padel quarter-zip in a dark kitchen at dawn, lit by his phone, thumbing the group chat with a grin, while a baby monitor on the counter shows Alfie standing up in his cot and wailing.
